tests.details: Successfully parsed OpenSafetySync and OpenSafetyBlackChannelSync with 11 variables. Bound registers: %M261, %M262, %R1120, %R1121, %R1122, %R1123, %R1124, %R1125, %R1126, %R1127.
Ladder logic contacts and coils strictly intercepted with ERR_LADDER_FORBIDDEN.
Dual subframes (P and ~P) serialized (36 bytes) and deserialized bit-for-bit identical.
Corrupted redundant safety payload trapped with 0xB001 (OPENSAFETY_ERR_CRC_MISMATCH), %M262 asserted, %M261 cleared.
Replay and sequence gap attacks trapped deterministically with 0xB002 (OPENSAFETY_ERR_SEQUENCE_GAP).
Excessive latency (35,000 us) and silence watchdog (60,000 us) trapped with 0xB003 (OPENSAFETY_ERR_TIMEOUT).
Alien safety domain ID (0x9999) rejected with 0xB004 (OPENSAFETY_ERR_DOMAIN_COLLISION).
Horner OCS registers (%R1120..%R1127, %M261..%M262) verified across healthy, tripped (0xB004), and operator reset states.
